That could diverge! Actually PHP's readdir uses readdir(3) → includes "." and "..". If elephc filters them, first two entries differ. Good probe: ```php mkdir("dtest"); touch("dtest/x.txt"); $d = opendir("dtest"); echo readdir($d), "\n"; // "." echo readdir($d), "\n"; // ".." closedir($d); ``` Directory order ".",".." is reliable on ext4; macOS too. scandir sorts so fine. Also `dir()` class, `Directory` object->read(). Also `is_link`, `lstat` vs `stat` — lstat on a symlink: mode bits differ (0120000 mask). Program: ```php symlink("keep.txt", "link.txt"); $s = stat("link.txt"); $l = lstat("link.txt"); var_dump($s["size"] === $l["size"]); // false: target size vs link length var_dump(decoct($l["mode"] & 0770000)); // "120000" var_dump(is_link("link.txt"), is_link("keep.txt")); ``` symlink in harness environment — needs FS write permission; previous programs did file ops (copy) so fine.
